# NyayMitra
> Online legal services platform for India. AI-powered legal guidance, verified lawyers, affidavit drafting. Available in Hindi and English.

## Key pages
- https://mynyaymitra.in/ : Homepage — overview of all services
- https://mynyaymitra.in/legal-gpt : Legal AI chat trained on Indian law
- https://mynyaymitra.in/affidavit-online-india : Online affidavit drafting from ₹999
- https://mynyaymitra.in/lawyers : Find verified lawyers across India
- https://mynyaymitra.in/services : All legal document and drafting services
- https://mynyaymitra.in/about : About NyayMitra
- https://mynyaymitra.in/contact : Contact and support

## About

- Headquarters: Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560034, India

- Coverage: All India — Patna, Lucknow, Indore, Jaipur, Ranchi, Bengaluru, Delhi, Mumbai

## Services
- Legal AI consultation (free, 24/7, Hindi & English)
- Online affidavit drafting and notarization (₹999+, 2-4 hour delivery)
- Verified lawyer consultations (₹299+ per 30 min)
- Legal document generation (rent agreements, legal notices, complaints)
- FIR guidance and police complaint support
- Property dispute assistance
- Family law and divorce guidance
- Consumer complaint and cyber fraud support

## Lawyer network
- 60+ verified advocates enrolled under Advocates Act, 1961
- Specializations: Civil, Criminal, Family, Property, Consumer, Labour, Cyber Crime
- Background-checked and Bar Council verified

## Technology
- Platform type: LegalTech marketplace (not a law firm)
- AI: Trained on Indian legal code, IPC, CPC, and landmark judgments
- Availability: WhatsApp, Web, Mobile app
